verses.1:1: And the Lord summoned Moses and spoke to him from the tent of testimony, saying,
verses.1:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel and you shall say to them, 'If a person among you brings gifts to the Lord, from the livestock, both from the cattle and from the sheep, you shall present your gifts.
verses.1:3: If his gift is a whole burnt offering from the cattle, he shall bring an unblemished male; he shall present it at the door of the tent of testimony, acceptable for him before the Lord.
verses.1:4: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the fire offering, acceptable for him, to make atonement on his behalf.
verses.1:5: And they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord; and the priests, the sons of Aaron, shall present the blood and pour out the blood all around on the altar that is at the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.1:6: And having skinned the whole burnt offering, they shall cut it up piece by piece.
verses.1:7: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall place fire on the altar, and they shall stack wood on the fire.
verses.1:8: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall stack the cut pieces and the head and the fat on the wood that is on the fire which is on the altar;
verses.1:9: but they shall wash its entrails and its feet with water; and the priests shall place all of it on the altar. It is a fire offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:10: Now if his gift to the Lord is from the sheep, from both the lambs and the young goats, for a whole burnt offering, he shall bring it as an unblemished male,
verses.1:11: and he shall lay his hand on its head. And they shall slaughter it on the side of the altar toward the north before the Lord; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour out its blood all around on the altar.
verses.1:12: And they shall divide it piece by piece, and the head and the fat; and the priests shall stack them on the wood that is on the fire on the altar,
verses.1:13: and they shall wash the entrails and the feet with water; and the priest shall present all of it and place it on the altar. It is a fire offering of sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.1:14: Now if you present a fire offering from the birds as a gift to the Lord, then he shall present his gift from the turtledoves or from the pigeons.
verses.1:15: And the priest shall bring it to the altar and pinch off its head; and the priest shall place it on the altar, and he shall squeeze out the blood against the base of the altar.
verses.1:16: And he shall remove the crop with the feathers, and throw it out beside the altar toward the east into the place of the ashes.
verses.1:17: And he shall break it open by the wings and shall not divide it; and the priest shall place it on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire. It is a fire offering, a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.'"
verses.2:1: Now if a person presents a gift, a sacrifice, to the Lord, his gift shall be fine flour; and he shall pour oil on it, and he shall place frankincense on it. It is a sacrifice.
verses.2:2: And he shall bring it to the sons of Aaron, the priests; and having grasped from it a full handful of the fine flour with the oil, and all its frankincense, the priest shall place its memorial on the altar: a sacrifice, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:3: And the remainder from the sacrifice belongs to Aaron and to his sons, a most holy thing from the sacrifices of the Lord.
verses.2:4: Now if one presents a gift, a sacrifice baked from frankincense, it shall be a gift to the Lord from fine flour: unleavened loaves kneaded with oil and unleavened flat cakes spread with oil.
verses.2:5: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a frying pan, it is fine flour kneaded with oil, unleavened;
verses.2:6: and you shall break it into pieces and pour oil on it; it is a sacrifice to the Lord.
verses.2:7: And if your gift is a sacrifice from a hearth, it shall be made with oil.
verses.2:8: And he shall present to the Lord the sacrifice that he makes from these, and he shall bring it to the priest; and having come near to the altar,
verses.2:9: the priest shall remove from the sacrifice its memorial, and the priest shall place it on the altar: a fire offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:10: Now what is left over from the sacrifice belongs to Aaron and to his sons, most holy things from the fire offerings of the Lord.
verses.2:11: No sacrifice that you present to the Lord shall you make leavened; for of all leaven and all honey, you shall not present any of it to offer as a fire offering to the Lord.
verses.2:12: As a gift of firstfruits you shall present them to the Lord; but they shall not be brought up onto the altar for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.2:13: And every gift of your sacrifice shall be salted with salt; you shall not let the salt of the covenant of the Lord cease from your sacrificial offerings; upon every gift of yours you shall present salt to the Lord your God.
verses.2:14: Now if you present a sacrifice of first-produce to the Lord, it shall be tender, fresh, roasted, crushed groats to the Lord; and you shall present the sacrifice of the first-produce,
verses.2:15: and you shall pour oil on it, and you shall place frankincense on it. It is a sacrifice.
verses.2:16: And the priest shall offer up its memorial from the groats with the oil and all its frankincense. It is a fire offering to the Lord.
verses.3:1: Now if his gift to the Lord is a sacrifice of deliverance, if he brings it from his cattle, whether a male or a female, he shall bring it unblemished before the Lord.
verses.3:2: And he shall lay his hands on the head of the gift, and he shall slaughter it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour out the blood all around on the altar of the whole burnt offerings.
verses.3:3: And they shall bring from the sacrifice of deliverance a fire offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,
verses.3:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and he shall remove the lobe that is on the liver along with the kidneys.
verses.3:5: And the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall offer them up on the altar, upon the whole burnt offerings, on the wood that is on the fire on the altar: a fire offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord.
verses.3:6: Now if his gift is from the sheep, a sacrifice of deliverance to the Lord, male or female, he shall present it unblemished.
verses.3:7: If he brings a lamb as his gift, he shall bring it before the Lord;
verses.3:8: and he shall lay his hands on the head of his gift, and he shall slaughter it beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour out the blood all around on the altar.
verses.3:9: And he shall present from the sacrifice of deliverance a fire offering to God: the fat and the unblemished loin—he shall remove it along with the loin muscles—and the fat of the belly,
verses.3:10: and both kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and having removed the lobe that is on the liver along with the kidneys,
verses.3:11: the priest shall offer them up on the altar: an aroma of sweet fragrance, a fire offering to the Lord.
verses.3:12: Now if his gift is from the goats, then he shall bring it before the Lord;
verses.3:13: and he shall lay his hands on its head, and they shall slaughter it before the Lord beside the doors of the tent of testimony; and the sons of Aaron, the priests, shall pour out the blood all around on the altar.
verses.3:14: And he shall offer up upon it a fire offering to the Lord: the fat that covers the belly and all the fat that is on the belly,
verses.3:15: and both kidneys and all the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs; and he shall remove the lobe of the liver along with the kidneys.
verses.3:16: And the priest shall offer them up on the altar: a fire offering, an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord. All the fat belongs to the Lord.
verses.3:17: It is a statute forever for your generations in every dwelling of yours: you shall not eat any fat or any blood.
verses.4:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.4:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'If a person sins before the Lord unintentionally against any of the ordinances of the Lord which must not be done, and does any one of them:
verses.4:3: If the anointed high priest sins so that the people sin, then he shall bring for his sin which he sinned a calf from the cattle without blemish to the Lord for his sin.
verses.4:4: And he shall bring the calf to the door of the tent of testimony before the Lord, and he shall lay his hand on the head of the calf before the Lord, and he shall slaughter the calf before the Lord.
verses.4:5: And the anointed priest whose hands have been consecrated shall take some of the blood of the calf and bring it into the tent of testimony;
verses.4:6: and the priest shall dip his finger into the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before the Lord toward the holy veil;
verses.4:7: and the priest shall put some of the blood of the calf on the horns of the altar of compounded incense before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony; and all the blood of the calf he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offerings, which is at the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.4:8: And all the fat of the calf of the sin offering he shall remove from it: the fat that covers the entrails and all the fat that is on the entrails,
verses.4:9: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the thighs, and the lobe that is on the liver—along with the kidneys he shall remove it,
verses.4:10: in the same way you remove it from the calf of the sacrifice of deliverance; the priest shall bring it up onto the altar of the whole burnt offering.
verses.4:11: And the hide of the calf and all its flesh, with the head and the extremities and the belly and the dung,
verses.4:12: they shall carry out the whole calf outside the camp to a clean place where they pour out the ashes, and they shall burn it up on wood with fire; at the place of the pouring out of the ashes it shall be burned.
verses.4:13: Now if the entire congregation of Israel acts in ignorance unintentionally, and a matter escapes from the eyes of the congregation, and they do any one of all the commandments of the Lord which is not to be done and incur guilt,
verses.4:14: and the sin which they sinned in it becomes known to them, then the congregation shall bring a calf from the cattle without blemish for the sin offering, and shall bring it to the doors of the tent of testimony.
verses.4:15: And the elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the calf before the Lord, and they shall slaughter the calf before the Lord;
verses.4:16: and the anointed priest shall bring some of the blood of the calf into the tent of testimony;
verses.4:17: and the priest shall dip his finger in some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle it seven times before the Lord, in front of the holy veil;
verses.4:18: and the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of compounded incense, which is before the Lord, which is in the tent of testimony; and all the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of whole burnt offerings, which is at the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.4:19: And all the fat he shall remove from it and offer up on the altar;
verses.4:20: and he shall do to the calf in the same way he did to the calf of the sin offering; so it shall be done. And the priest shall make atonement for them, and the sin will be forgiven them.
verses.4:21: And they shall carry out the calf outside the camp and burn up the calf in the same way they burned up the first calf; it is a sin offering of the congregation.
verses.4:22: Now if the ruler sins and does any one of all the commandments of the Lord their God which is not to be done, unintentionally, and sins and incurs guilt,
verses.4:23: and the sin which he sinned in it becomes known to him, then he shall offer as his gift a young goat from the goats, a male without blemish.
verses.4:24: And he shall lay his hand on the head of the young goat, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the burnt offerings before the Lord; it is a sin offering.
verses.4:25: And the priest shall put some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger on the horns of the altar of burnt offerings, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offerings.
verses.4:26: And all its fat he shall offer up on the altar, like the fat of a sacrifice of deliverance; and the priest shall make atonement for him from his sin, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.4:27: Now if one person from the people of the land sins unintentionally by doing any one of all the commandments of the Lord which is not to be done, and incurs guilt,
verses.4:28: and the sin which he sinned in it becomes known to him, then he shall bring a young goat from the goats; a female without blemish he shall bring for the sin which he sinned.
verses.4:29: And he shall lay his hand on the head of his sin offering, and they shall slaughter the young goat of the sin offering in the place where they slaughter the burnt offerings.
verses.4:30: And the priest shall take some of its blood with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offerings, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.
verses.4:31: And all the fat he shall remove in the same way fat is removed from a sacrifice of deliverance, and the priest shall offer it up on the altar for an aroma of sweet fragrance to the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.4:32: And if he offers a sheep as his gift for a sin offering, he shall offer it, a female without blemish.
verses.4:33: And he shall lay his hand on its head, the sin offering, and they shall slaughter it in the place where they slaughter the burnt offerings.
verses.4:34: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger and put it on the horns of the altar of the burnt offering, and all its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of the burnt offering.
verses.4:35: And all its fat he shall remove in the same way the fat of a sheep is removed from the sacrifice of deliverance, and the priest shall put it on the altar upon the burnt offering of the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him for the sin which he sinned, and it will be forgiven him.'"
verses.5:1: "Now if a person sins and hears the voice of an adjuration, and he is a witness, whether he has seen or knows of it, if he does not report it, he shall bear the sin.
verses.5:2: Or a person who touches any unclean thing—whether a carcass or something unclean torn by wild beasts, or the carcasses or the unclean abominations, or the carcasses of unclean livestock—
verses.5:3: or touches any uncleanness of a human being, any of his uncleanness by which, upon touching it, he becomes defiled, and it escaped him, yet afterward he comes to know it and incurs guilt;
verses.5:4: or a lawless person who pronounces with his lips to do evil or to do good, according to all that a man may pronounce with an oath, and it escapes him before his eyes, and he comes to know it and sins in any one of these things,
verses.5:5: then he shall confess the sin concerning the things he has sinned regarding it,
verses.5:6: and he shall bring to the Lord for the things in which he incurred guilt, for the sin which he sinned, a female from the flock—a ewe lamb or a young goat from the goats—for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin which he sinned, and the sin will be forgiven him.
verses.5:7: But if his hand cannot provide what is sufficient for the sheep, he shall bring for his sin which he sinned two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the Lord, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering.
verses.5:8: And he shall bring them to the priest, and the priest shall present the one for the sin offering first; and the priest shall pinch off its head from the neck vertebra and shall not divide it,
verses.5:9: and he shall sprinkle some of the blood of the sin offering on the wall of the altar, and the rest of the blood he shall squeeze out at the base of the altar; for it is a sin offering.
verses.5:10: And the second he shall prepare as a burnt offering, as is proper; and the priest shall make atonement for his sin which he sinned, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.5:11: Now if his hand does not find a pair of turtledoves or two young pigeons, then he shall bring as his gift for what he sinned the tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a sin offering; he shall not pour oil on it, nor shall he put frankincense on it, because it is a sin offering.
verses.5:12: And he shall bring it to the priest. And the priest shall take from it a full handful—its memorial portion—and put it on the altar of burnt offerings to the Lord; it is a sin offering.
verses.5:13: And the priest shall make atonement for him for his sin which he sinned in any one of these things, and it will be forgiven him. And what is left over shall belong to the priest, like the sacrifice of fine flour."
verses.5:14: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:15: "If something completely escapes a person and he sins unintentionally regarding the holy things of the Lord, then he shall bring for his guilt offering to the Lord a ram without blemish from the flock, valued in silver shekels, by the shekel of the sanctuary, for that in which he incurred guilt.
verses.5:16: And what he sinned against the holy things he shall repay, and he shall add one-fifth to it and give it to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him with the ram of the guilt offering, and it will be forgiven him.
verses.5:17: And the person who sins and does any one of all the commandments of the Lord which must not be done, and did not know it, yet incurs guilt and bears the sin,
verses.5:18: then he shall bring a ram without blemish from the flock, valued in silver, for a guilt offering to the priest; and the priest shall make atonement for him for his ignorance in which he acted in ignorance and he himself did not know it, and it will be forgiven him;
verses.5:19: for he has certainly incurred guilt before the Lord."
verses.5:20: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.5:21: "If a person sins and utterly disregards the commandments of the Lord, and lies in matters with his neighbor about a deposit, or about a partnership, or about robbery, or has wronged his neighbor in anything,
verses.5:22: or has found lost property and lies about it, and swears falsely concerning any one of all the things that a man may do so as to sin in them,
verses.5:23: then it shall be, whenever he sins and incurs guilt, that he shall return the plunder which he seized, or the wrongful gain by which he did wrong, or the deposit which was deposited with him, or the lost property which he found,
verses.5:24: or anything about which he swore falsely—he shall repay the principal itself, and he shall add one-fifth to it; to whomever it belongs, to him he shall return it on the day he is convicted.
verses.5:25: And for his guilt offering he shall bring to the Lord a ram from the flock without blemish, of the valuation for that in which he incurred guilt.
verses.5:26: And the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord, and it will be forgiven him for any one of all the things which he did and incurred guilt by it."
verses.6:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:2: "Command Aaron and his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the burnt offering: The burnt offering itself shall be on its burning on the altar all night until the morning, and the fire of the altar shall burn on it; it shall not be extinguished.
verses.6:3: And the priest shall put on a linen tunic, and he shall put on linen undergarments around his body, and he shall remove the burnt residue that the fire consumes, the burnt offering, from the altar, and he shall place it beside the altar.
verses.6:4: And he shall take off his robe and put on another robe, and he shall carry the burnt residue outside the camp to a clean place.
verses.6:5: And fire on the altar shall burn from it and shall not be extinguished; and the priest shall burn wood on it in the morning, and he shall arrange the burnt offering on it, and he shall place the fat of the deliverance offering on it.
verses.6:6: And fire shall burn continually on the altar; it shall not be extinguished.
verses.6:7: This is the law of the sacrifice that the sons of Aaron shall present before the Lord in front of the altar:
verses.6:8: And he shall remove a handful from it, from the fine flour of the sacrifice with its oil and with its frankincense, the things that are on the sacrifice, and he shall offer it up on the altar as an offering, a fragrant aroma, its memorial to the Lord.
verses.6:9: And what is left over from it Aaron and his sons shall eat; it shall be eaten unleavened in a holy place; in the courtyard of the tent of testimony they shall eat it.
verses.6:10: It shall not be baked leavened; I have given it to them as a portion from the offerings of the Lord; it is most holy, just like the sin offering and just like the trespass offering.
verses.6:11: Every male among the priests shall eat it; it is an eternal statute for your generations from the offerings of the Lord. Everyone who touches them shall become holy.'"
verses.6:12: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:13: "This is the gift of Aaron and his sons that they shall offer to the Lord on the day when you anoint him: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour for a continual sacrifice, half of it in the morning and half of it in the evening.
verses.6:14: It shall be prepared on a griddle in oil; he shall bring it kneaded, rolled pieces, a sacrifice of broken pieces, a sacrifice, a fragrant aroma to the Lord.
verses.6:15: The priest who is anointed in his place from among his sons shall prepare it; it is an eternal law; all of it shall be fully performed.
verses.6:16: And every sacrifice of a priest shall be wholly burned, and it shall not be eaten."
verses.6:17: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.6:18: "Speak to Aaron and to his sons, saying, 'This is the law of the sin offering: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering, they shall slaughter the sin offering before the Lord; it is most holy.
verses.6:19: The priest who offers it up shall eat it; it shall be eaten in a holy place, in the courtyard of the tent of testimony.
verses.6:20: Everyone who touches its flesh shall become holy; and if on anyone some of its blood is sprinkled onto the garment, whoever is sprinkled on it shall be washed in a holy place.
verses.6:21: And an earthenware vessel in which it is boiled shall be shattered; but if it is boiled in a bronze vessel, he shall scour it and rinse it out with water.
verses.6:22: Every male among the priests shall eat it; it is most holy to the Lord.
verses.6:23: And all the sin offerings, any of whose blood is brought into the tent of testimony to make atonement in the holy place, shall not be eaten; they shall be burned up in fire.'"
verses.7:1: "And this is the law of the ram for trespass: it is most holy.
verses.7:2: In the place where they slaughter the burnt offering, they shall slaughter the ram of trespass before the Lord, and he shall pour out the blood on the base of the altar all around;
verses.7:3: and he shall offer all its fat from it, and the loin, and all the fat that covers the inward parts, and all the fat that is on the inward parts,
verses.7:4: and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, that which is on the thighs, and the lobe that is on the liver; together with the kidneys he shall remove them;
verses.7:5: and the priest shall offer them up on the altar as an offering to the Lord; it is for trespass.
verses.7:6: Every male from among the priests shall eat it; in a holy place they shall eat it; it is most holy.
verses.7:7: Just as the sin offering is, so also is the trespass offering; there is one law for them: as for the priest who makes atonement, it shall be in his possession.
verses.7:8: And as for the priest who presents a person's burnt offering, the hide of the burnt offering that he himself offers shall belong to him.
verses.7:9: And every sacrifice that is prepared in the oven, and every one that is prepared on a grill or on a griddle, belongs to the priest who offers it; it shall be his.
verses.7:10: And every sacrifice mixed with oil and not mixed shall belong to all the sons of Aaron, to each an equal share.
verses.7:11: This is the law of the sacrifice of deliverance that they shall offer to the Lord.
verses.7:12: If he offers it for praise, then he shall offer with the sacrifice of praise loaves of fine flour mixed with oil, unleavened wafers spread with oil, and fine flour kneaded with oil;
verses.7:13: with leavened loaves he shall offer his gifts, along with a deliverance sacrifice of praise.
verses.7:14: And he shall present one from all his gifts as a set-apart portion to the Lord; it shall belong to the priest who pours out the blood of the deliverance offering.
verses.7:15: And the flesh of the deliverance sacrifice of praise shall belong to him; and on the day it is given, it shall be eaten; they shall not leave any of it until the morning.
verses.7:16: And if he sacrifices his gift as a vow or a freewill offering, on whatever day he presents his sacrifice it shall be eaten, and on the next day;
verses.7:17: and what is left over from the flesh of the sacrifice until the third day shall be burned up in fire.
verses.7:18: But if he actually eats from the flesh on the third day, it shall not be accepted for him who offers it; it shall not be credited to him; it is a defilement; and the soul that eats from it shall bear the sin.
verses.7:19: And whatever flesh touches anything unclean shall not be eaten; it shall be burned up in fire; everyone who is clean shall eat flesh.
verses.7:20: But the soul that eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of deliverance that belongs to the Lord, while his uncleanness is on him, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
verses.7:21: And a soul that touches any unclean thing, whether from the uncleanness of a person, or of unclean four-footed animals, or any unclean abomination, and eats from the flesh of the sacrifice of deliverance that belongs to the Lord, that soul shall be destroyed from its people."
verses.7:22: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:23: "Speak to the sons of Israel: 'You shall not eat any fat of cattle and sheep and goats.
verses.7:24: And the fat of animals that die naturally, and what is torn by wild beasts, may be used for any work, yet for food it shall not be eaten;
verses.7:25: as for everyone who eats fat from the livestock from which one presents an offering of the Lord, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.
verses.7:26: You shall not eat any blood in all the land, your dwelling place, both from the birds and from the livestock.
verses.7:27: Every soul that eats blood, that soul shall be destroyed from its people.'"
verses.7:28: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.7:29: "And you shall speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'The one who offers a sacrifice of deliverance to the Lord shall bring his gift to the Lord, even from the sacrifice of deliverance;
verses.7:30: his own hands shall offer the offerings to the Lord: the fat that is on the breast and the lobe of the liver, he shall offer them so as to place them as a gift before the Lord.
verses.7:31: And the priest shall offer up the fat on the altar, and the breast shall belong to Aaron and shall belong to his sons.
verses.7:32: And you shall give the right shoulder as a set-apart portion to the priest from your sacrifices of deliverance;
verses.7:33: as for the one who offers the blood of the deliverance offering and the fat, that which is from the sons of Aaron, to him the right shoulder shall belong as a portion.
verses.7:34: For I have taken the breast of the placed offering and the shoulder of the set-apart portion from the sons of Israel, from your sacrifices of deliverance, and I have given them to Aaron the priest and to his sons as an eternal statute from the sons of Israel.'"
verses.7:35: This is the anointing of Aaron and the anointing of his sons from the offerings of the Lord, on the day when He brought them near to serve as priests to the Lord,
verses.7:36: just as the Lord commanded to give to them on the day when He anointed them, from the sons of Israel; it is an eternal statute for their generations.
verses.7:37: This is the law of the burnt offerings, and of the sacrifice, and of the offering for sin, and of the trespass offering, and of consecration, and of the sacrifice of deliverance,
verses.7:38: in the manner that the Lord commanded Moses on Mount Sinai, on the day when He commanded the sons of Israel to offer their gifts before the Lord in the wilderness of Sinai.
verses.8:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.8:2: "Take Aaron and his sons and his garments, and the anointing oil, and the young bull for the sin offering, and the two rams, and the basket of unleavened bread;
verses.8:3: and assemble all the congregation at the door of the tent of testimony."
verses.8:4: And Moses did just as the Lord ordered him, and he assembled the congregation at the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.8:5: And Moses said to the congregation, "This is the word, this is what the Lord commanded to do."
verses.8:6: And Moses presented Aaron and his sons, and washed them with water.
verses.8:7: And he clothed them with the tunic and fastened the sash around them; and he clothed him with the robe and placed the shoulder-piece upon him,
verses.8:8: and he wrapped him according to the workmanship of the shoulder-piece and fastened him tightly with it; and he placed the oracle upon it, and placed the manifestation and the truth upon the oracle.
verses.8:9: And he placed the turban upon his head, and he placed upon the turban, in front of his face, the golden plate, dedicated as holy, just as the Lord ordered Moses.
verses.8:10: And Moses took some of the anointing oil,
verses.8:11: and he sprinkled some of it upon the altar seven times; and he anointed the altar and sanctified it, and all its utensils, and the basin and its base, and sanctified them; and he anointed the tent and all that was in it, and sanctified it.
verses.8:12: And Moses poured some of the anointing oil upon the head of Aaron, and he anointed him and sanctified him.
verses.8:13: And Moses brought forward the sons of Aaron, and clothed them with tunics, and fastened sashes around them, and put headdresses on them, just as the Lord ordered Moses.
verses.8:14: And Moses brought forward the young bull for the sin offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the young bull of the sin offering.
verses.8:15: And he slaughtered it; and Moses took some of the blood and put it on the horns of the altar all around with his finger, and purified the altar; and he poured out the blood at the base of the altar, and sanctified it to make atonement upon it.
verses.8:16: And Moses took all the fat that was on the inward parts, and a lobe from the liver, and both kidneys and the fat that was on them, and Moses offered them up on the altar.
verses.8:17: And the young bull and its hide and its flesh and its dung, he burned them up with fire outside the camp, just as the Lord ordered Moses.
verses.8:18: And Moses brought forward the ram for a whole burnt offering, and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram. And Moses slaughtered the ram, and Moses poured the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.8:20: And he cut up the ram into pieces, and Moses offered up the head and the pieces and the fat.
verses.8:21: And he washed the belly and the feet with water, and Moses offered up the whole ram on the altar; a whole burnt offering that is for a fragrance of sweet aroma, it is a sacrificial offering to the Lord, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.8:22: And Moses brought forward the second ram, a ram of consecration; and Aaron and his sons laid their hands on the head of the ram.
verses.8:23: And he slaughtered it, and Moses took some of its blood and put it on the lobe of Aaron's right ear, and on the tip of his right hand, and on the tip of his right foot.
verses.8:24: And Moses brought forward the sons of Aaron; and Moses put some of the blood on the lobes of their right ears, and on the tips of their right hands, and on the tips of their right feet; and Moses poured the blood upon the altar all around.
verses.8:25: And he took the fat, and the loin, and the fat that was on the belly, and the lobe of the liver, and the two kidneys and the fat that was on them, and the right shoulder.
verses.8:26: And from the basket of consecration that was before the Lord he took one unleavened loaf, and one loaf made with oil, and one flat cake, and he placed them on the fat, and he placed the right shoulder on top.
verses.8:27: And he placed all of them upon the hands of Aaron and upon the hands of his sons, and he offered them up as a set-apart offering before the Lord.
verses.8:28: And Moses took them from their hands, and Moses offered them up on the altar, upon the whole burnt offering of consecration, which is a fragrance of sweet aroma; it is a sacrificial offering to the Lord.
verses.8:29: And taking the breast, Moses set it apart as a placed offering before the Lord from the ram of consecration; and it became a portion for Moses, just as the Lord commanded Moses. And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron and his garments and his sons.
verses.8:30: And Moses took some of the anointing oil and some of the blood that was on the altar, and sprinkled it upon Aaron, and his garments, and his sons, and the garments of his sons with him, and the garments of his sons with him.
verses.8:31: And Moses said to Aaron and his sons, "Boil the flesh in the courtyard of the tent of testimony in a holy place, and there you shall eat it and the loaves in the basket of consecration, just as it has been ordered to me, saying, 'Aaron and his sons shall eat these.'
verses.8:32: And what is left over of the flesh and of the loaves shall be burned up in fire.
verses.8:33: And you shall not go out from the door of the tent of testimony for seven days, until the day of your consecration is fulfilled; for seven days he will consecrate your hands,
verses.8:34: just as he did on this day, on which the Lord commanded to do so, in order to make atonement for you.
verses.8:35: And you shall remain at the door of the tent of testimony for seven days, day and night; you shall keep the observances of the Lord, so that you may not die; for so the Lord God commanded me."
verses.8:36: And Aaron and his sons did all the words that the Lord ordered Moses.
verses.9:1: And it happened on the eighth day that Moses called Aaron and his sons and the council of elders of Israel.
verses.9:2: And Moses said to Aaron, "Take for yourself a tender calf from the cattle for a sin offering, and a ram for a whole burnt offering, without blemish, and present them before the Lord;
verses.9:3: and speak to the council of elders of Israel, saying, 'Take one male goat from the goats for a sin offering, and a calf and a year-old lamb for a whole offering, without blemish,
verses.9:4: and a young bull and a ram for a sacrifice of deliverance before the Lord, and fine flour mixed with oil; for today the Lord will appear among you.'"
verses.9:5: And they took them, just as Moses commanded, in front of the tent of testimony; and all the congregation approached and stood before the Lord.
verses.9:6: And Moses said, "Do this word that the Lord spoke, and the glory of the Lord will appear among you."
verses.9:7: And Moses said to Aaron, "Approach the altar, and offer your sin offering and your whole burnt offering, and make atonement for yourself and your house; and offer the gifts of the people, and make atonement for them, just as the Lord commanded Moses."
verses.9:8: And Aaron approached the altar, and slaughtered the calf for the sin offering.
verses.9:9: And the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he dipped his finger into the blood and put it on the horns of the altar, and poured out the blood at the base of the altar.
verses.9:10: And the fat, and the kidneys, and the lobe of the liver of the sin offering he offered up on the altar, just as the Lord commanded Moses.
verses.9:11: And the flesh and the hide, he burned them up with fire outside the camp.
verses.9:12: And he slaughtered the whole burnt offering; and the sons of Aaron also brought the blood to him, and he poured it upon the altar all around.
verses.9:13: And the whole burnt offering, they brought it in pieces, them and the head, and he placed them on the altar.
verses.9:14: And he washed the belly and the feet with water, and placed them upon the whole burnt offering on the altar.
verses.9:15: And they presented the gift of the people; and he took the male goat for the sin offering of the people, and slaughtered it just as the first one.
verses.9:16: And he presented the whole burnt offering, and offered it as is proper.
verses.9:17: And he presented the sacrifice, and filled his hands from it, and placed it on the altar besides the morning whole burnt offering.
verses.9:18: And he slaughtered the young bull and the ram of the sacrifice of deliverance of the people; and the sons of Aaron brought the blood to him, and he poured it against the altar all around.
verses.9:19: And the fat from the young bull and the ram, the loin, and the fat that covered the belly, and the two kidneys and the fat that was on them, and the lobe that was on the liver;
verses.9:20: and he placed the fat portions upon the breasts, and they offered up the fat portions on the altar.
verses.9:21: And the breast and the right shoulder Aaron set apart as a set-apart offering before the Lord, just as the Lord ordered Moses.
verses.9:22: And lifting up his hands toward the people, Aaron blessed them, and he came down after offering the sin offering, and the whole burnt offerings, and the offerings of deliverance.
verses.9:23: And Moses and Aaron entered into the tent of testimony, and coming out they blessed all the people; and the glory of the Lord appeared to all the people.
verses.9:24: And fire came out from the Lord, and consumed the things on the altar, both the whole burnt offerings and the fat portions; and all the people saw and were amazed, and they fell on their faces.
verses.10:1: And the two sons of Aaron, Nadab and Abihu, each taking his firepan, put fire on it and placed incense on it, and offered strange fire before the Lord, which the Lord had not commanded them.
verses.10:2: And fire came out from the Lord and devoured them, and they died before the Lord.
verses.10:3: And Moses said to Aaron, "This is what the Lord spoke, saying, 'Among those who draw near to Me I will be sanctified, and in the whole congregation I will be glorified.'" And Aaron was deeply stricken.
verses.10:4: And Moses called Misadai and Elizaphan, sons of Aziel, sons of the brother of Aaron's father, and said to them, "Come forward and carry your brothers from before the sanctuary outside the camp."
verses.10:5: And they came forward and carried them in their tunics outside the camp, just as Moses had said.
verses.10:6: And Moses said to Aaron and Eleazar and Ithamar, his remaining sons, "You shall not remove the turban from your head and you shall not tear your garments, so that you will not die, nor wrath come upon the whole congregation; your brothers, the whole house of Israel, shall weep for the burning with which they were burned by the Lord.
verses.10:7: And you shall not go out from the door of the tent of testimony, so that you will not die, for the anointing oil from the Lord is upon you." And they did according to the word of Moses.
verses.10:8: And the Lord spoke to Aaron, saying,
verses.10:9: "Wine and strong drink you shall not drink, you and your sons with you, whenever you enter the tent of testimony, or when you approach the altar, and you will certainly not die; it is an eternal ordinance throughout your generations,
verses.10:10: to distinguish between the holy and the profane, and between the unclean and the clean.
verses.10:11: And you shall teach the sons of Israel all the ordinances that the Lord spoke to them by the hand of Moses."
verses.10:12: And Moses said to Aaron and to Eleazar and Ithamar, the sons of Aaron who were left, "Take the offering that was left from the offerings by fire of the Lord, and eat it unleavened beside the altar; it is most holy.
verses.10:13: And you shall eat it in a holy place, for this is an eternal ordinance for you and an ordinance for your sons from the offerings by fire of the Lord; for so it has been commanded to me.
verses.10:14: And the breast of the separated offering and the shoulder of the contribution you shall eat in a holy place, you and your sons and your household with you; for it has been given as an ordinance for you and an ordinance for your sons from the sacrifices of deliverance of the sons of Israel.
verses.10:15: The shoulder of the contribution and the breast of the separated offering they shall bring along with the offerings by fire of the fat portions, to set apart as a separated offering before the Lord; and it shall be for you and for your sons and for your daughters with you an eternal ordinance, just as the Lord commanded Moses."
verses.10:16: Now Moses searched diligently for the male goat of the sin offering, and look, it had been burned up; and Moses became angry with Eleazar and Ithamar, the remaining sons of Aaron, saying,
verses.10:17: "Why did you not eat the sin offering in a holy place? For since it is most holy, He gave this to you to eat, so that you might take away the sin of the congregation and make atonement for them before the Lord.
verses.10:18: For none of its blood was brought into the sanctuary; you shall eat it right inside, in a holy place, just as the Lord commanded me."
verses.10:19: And Aaron spoke to Moses, saying, "If today they have offered their sin offerings and their whole burnt offerings before the Lord, and these things have happened to me, and I eat the sin offerings today, would it be pleasing to the Lord?"
verses.10:20: And Moses heard, and it pleased him.
verses.11:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.11:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, saying, 'These are the animals that you may eat from among the animals that are on the earth:
verses.11:3: Every animal that divides the hoof and splits hoof-clefts of two claws and brings up the cud, among the animals, these you may eat.
verses.11:4: However, from these you shall not eat, from those that bring up the cud and from those that divide the hooves and split hoof-clefts: the camel, because it brings up the cud yet does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you;
verses.11:5: and the hare, because it brings up the cud and does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you;
verses.11:6: and the rock badger, because it brings up the cud and does not divide the hoof, it is unclean to you.
verses.11:7: And the pig, because it divides the hoof and splits the claws of the hoof, yet it does not bring up the cud, it is unclean to you.
verses.11:8: You shall not eat from their meat, and you shall not touch their carcasses; they are unclean to you.
verses.11:9: And these are what you may eat from all that are in the waters: everything that has fins and scales, in the waters and in the seas and in the streams, these you may eat.
verses.11:10: And everything that does not have fins or scales, in the water or in the seas and in the streams, from all that the waters bring forth and from every living creature that is in the water, is a detestable thing; and they shall be detestable things
verses.11:11: for you; you shall not eat from their meat, and their carcasses you shall detest.
verses.11:12: And everything that does not have fins and scales among those in the water, it is a detestable thing to you.
verses.11:13: And these are what you shall detest among the winged creatures, and they shall not be eaten; they are a detestable thing: the eagle and the griffon vulture and the sea eagle,
verses.11:14: and the vulture and the kite and those like it,
verses.11:16: and the ostrich and the owl and the gull and those like it, and the hawk and those like it,
verses.11:17: and the night raven and the cormorant and the ibis,
verses.11:18: and the purple waterhen and the pelican and the swan,
verses.11:19: and the owl and the heron and the plover and those like it, and the hoopoe and the bat.
verses.11:20: And all the creeping things among the winged creatures that go on all fours are detestable things to you.
verses.11:21: Yet these you may eat from the creeping things among the winged creatures that go on all fours: any that has legs above its feet to leap with them on the earth.
verses.11:22: And these of them you may eat: the wingless locust and those like it, and the attakes and those like it, and the locust and those like it, and the snake-fighter and those like it.
verses.11:23: Every creeping thing among the winged creatures that has four feet, they are detestable things to you.
verses.11:24: And by these you will be defiled: everyone who touches their carcasses is unclean until evening,
verses.11:25: and everyone who carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:26: And among all the animals, any that divides the hoof and splits hoof-clefts and does not chew the cud, they shall be unclean to you; everyone who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:27: And every one that goes on paws among all the wild animals that go on all fours, they shall be unclean to you; everyone who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening,
verses.11:28: and the one who carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening; these are unclean to you.
verses.11:29: And these are unclean to you among the creeping things that are on the earth: the weasel and the mouse and the land crocodile,
verses.11:30: the shrew and the chameleon and the gecko and the lizard and the mole.
verses.11:31: These are unclean to you among all the creeping things that are on the earth; everyone who touches them when they are dead shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:32: And anything upon which any of them falls when they are dead shall be unclean, whether any wooden article, or garment, or skin, or sackcloth; every article with which work is done shall be dipped into water, and it shall be unclean until evening, and it shall be clean.
verses.11:33: And every clay vessel into the inside of which any of these falls, whatever is inside shall be unclean, and it itself shall be shattered.
verses.11:34: And every food that is eaten, upon which water comes, shall be unclean; and every drink that is drunk in any container shall be unclean.
verses.11:35: And anything upon which any of their carcasses falls shall be unclean; ovens and pot-stands shall be torn down; they are unclean, and they shall be unclean to you.
verses.11:36: However, springs of water and a cistern and a gathering of water shall be clean; but the one who touches their carcasses shall be unclean.
verses.11:37: And if any of their carcasses falls upon any sowing seed that is to be sown, it shall be clean;
verses.11:38: but if water is poured upon any seed, and any of their carcasses falls upon it, it is unclean to you.
verses.11:39: And if one of the animals that you may eat dies, the one who touches their carcasses shall be unclean until evening;
verses.11:40: and the one who eats from these carcasses shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening; and the one who carries any of their carcasses shall wash his garments and shall bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.11:41: And every creeping thing that creeps on the earth, it shall be a detestable thing to you; it shall not be eaten.
verses.11:42: And every one that goes on its belly, and every one that goes on all fours continually, any that has many feet among all the creeping things that creep on the earth, you shall not eat it, because it is a detestable thing to you.
verses.11:43: And you shall certainly not make your souls detestable with any of the creeping things that creep on the earth, and you shall not be defiled by these, and you shall not be unclean by them.
verses.11:44: For I am the Lord your God; and you shall be sanctified and you shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord your God; and you shall not defile your souls with any of the creeping things that move on the earth;
verses.11:45: for I am the Lord who brought you up out of the land of Egypt to be your God; and you shall be holy, for I am holy, the Lord.'"
verses.11:46: This is the law concerning the animals and the winged creatures and every creature that moves in the water and every creature that creeps on the earth,
verses.11:47: to distinguish between the unclean and the clean, and between those that bring forth alive what is eaten and those that bring forth alive what is not eaten.
verses.12:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.12:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'Any woman who receives seed and gives birth to a male shall be unclean for seven days; as during the days of the separation of her menstruation, she shall be unclean.
verses.12:3: And on the eighth day she shall circumcise the flesh of his foreskin.
verses.12:4: And for thirty-three days she shall remain in her unclean blood. She shall not touch any vessel, and she shall not enter the sanctuary until the days of her cleansing are completed.
verses.12:5: But if she gives birth to a female, then she shall be unclean for twice seven days, as during menstruation; and for sixty-six days she shall remain in her unclean blood.
verses.12:6: And when the days of her cleansing are fully completed, for a son or for a daughter, she shall bring a year-old lamb without blemish for a burnt offering and a young pigeon or a turtledove for a sin offering to the door of the tent of testimony, to the priest.
verses.12:7: And he shall offer them before the Lord, and the priest shall make atonement for her, and he shall cleanse her from the flow of her blood. This is the law for the woman who gives birth to a male or a female.
verses.12:8: But if her hand does not find what is sufficient for a lamb, then she shall take two turtledoves or two young pigeons, one for a burnt offering and one for a sin offering; and the priest shall make atonement for her, and she shall be cleansed.'"
verses.13:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.13:2: "If a bright scar of a mark occurs on any person in the skin of his flesh, and it becomes an affliction of leprosy in the skin of his flesh, then he shall be brought to Aaron the priest or one of his sons, the priests.
verses.13:3: And the priest shall see the affliction in the skin of his flesh, and if the hair in the affliction has turned white and the appearance of the affliction is lower than the skin of the flesh, it is an affliction of leprosy; and the priest shall see and declare him unclean.
verses.13:4: But if a bright white spot is in the skin of its flesh, and its appearance is not lower than its skin, and its hair has not turned to white hair, and it is dim, then the priest shall isolate the affliction for seven days.
verses.13:5: And the priest shall see the affliction on the seventh day, and look, the affliction remains before him; the affliction has not changed in the skin; then the priest shall isolate him for seven days a second time.
verses.13:6: And the priest shall see him on the seventh day a second time, and look, the affliction is dim; the affliction has not changed in the skin; the priest shall declare him clean, for it is a mark; and after washing his garments, he shall be clean.
verses.13:7: But if the mark turns and changes in the skin after the priest has seen him to declare him clean, then he shall appear before the priest a second time.
verses.13:8: And the priest shall see him, and look, the mark has changed in the skin; then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:9: And if an affliction of leprosy occurs on a person, then he shall come to the priest.
verses.13:10: And the priest shall see, and look, there is a white scar in the skin, and it has turned hair white, and some of the healthy part of the living flesh is in the scar,
verses.13:11: it is long-standing leprosy; it is in the skin of the flesh; and the priest shall declare him unclean and isolate him, because he is unclean.
verses.13:12: But if the leprosy breaks out thoroughly in the skin, and the leprosy covers all the skin of the affliction from head to feet throughout the entire sight of the priest,
verses.13:13: then the priest shall see, and look, the leprosy has covered all the skin of the flesh; and the priest shall declare him clean of the affliction; because it has all turned white, it is clean.
verses.13:14: And on whatever day living flesh appears on him, he shall be defiled.
verses.13:15: And the priest shall see the healthy flesh, and the healthy flesh shall defile him, because it is unclean; it is leprosy.
verses.13:16: But if the healthy flesh is restored and turns white, then he shall come to the priest.
verses.13:17: And the priest shall see, and look, the affliction has turned to white; then the priest shall declare the affliction clean; he is clean.
verses.13:18: And as for flesh, if a sore occurs in its skin, and it is healed,
verses.13:19: and in the place of the sore there occurs a white scar or a bright spot that is whitish or reddish, then he shall appear before the priest.
verses.13:20: And the priest shall see, and look, the appearance is lower than the skin, and its hair has turned to white; then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:21: But if the priest sees, and look, there is no white hair in it, and it is not lower than the skin of the flesh, and it is dim, the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.13:22: And if it spreads in the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction of leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:23: But if the bright spot remains in its place and does not spread, it is a scar of the sore, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:24: And as for flesh, if a burn from fire occurs in its skin, and in its skin the healed part of the burn becomes a bright white shining spot, somewhat reddish or very white,
verses.13:25: then the priest shall see him, and look, hair has turned white in the shining spot, and its appearance is lower than the skin; it is leprosy; it has broken out in the burn. And the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction of leprosy.
verses.13:26: But if the priest sees, and look, there is no white hair in the shining spot, and it is not lower than the skin, and it is dim, then the priest shall isolate him for seven days.
verses.13:27: And the priest shall see him on the seventh day; and if it spreads widely in the skin, then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is an affliction of leprosy; it has broken out in the sore.
verses.13:28: But if the shining spot remains in its place and does not spread in the skin, and it is dim, it is the scar of the burn, and the priest shall declare him clean, for it is the imprint of the burn.
verses.13:29: And as for a man and a woman, if an affliction of leprosy occurs on them on the head or on the beard,
verses.13:30: then the priest shall see the affliction, and look, its appearance is more sunken than the skin, and in it there is thin yellowish hair; then the priest shall declare him unclean; it is a scab; it is leprosy of the head or leprosy of the beard.
verses.13:31: And if the priest sees the affliction of the wound, and look, the appearance is not more sunken than the skin, and there is no yellowish hair in it, then the priest shall isolate the affliction of the scab for seven days.
verses.13:32: And the priest shall see the affliction on the seventh day, and look, the scab has not spread, and there is no yellowish hair in it, and the appearance of the scab is not sunken below the skin,
verses.13:33: then the skin shall be shaved, but the scab shall not be shaved; and the priest shall isolate the scab for seven days a second time.
verses.13:34: And the priest shall see the scab on the seventh day, and look, the scab has not spread in the skin after he has been shaved, and the appearance of the scab is not sunken below the skin; then the priest shall declare him clean; and after washing his garments, he shall be clean.
verses.13:35: But if the scab spreads widely in the skin after he has been declared clean,
verses.13:36: then the priest shall see, and look, the scab has spread in the skin; the priest shall not inspect for the yellow hair, because he is unclean.
verses.13:37: But if the scab remains in view in its place and black hair has sprung up in it, the scab has healed; it is clean, and the priest shall declare him clean.
verses.13:38: And as for a man or a woman, if a gleaming spot occurs in the skin of his flesh, shining whitish spots,
verses.13:39: then the priest shall see, and look, in the skin of his flesh there are gleaming spots, shining and whitish; it is a white rash, he is clean; it will break out in the skin of his flesh, he is clean.
verses.13:40: And if anyone's head loses its hair, he is bald; he is clean.
verses.13:41: And if his head loses its hair at the front, he is bald on the forehead; he is clean.
verses.13:42: But if a white or reddish affliction occurs on his bald head or on his bald forehead, it is leprosy on his bald head or on his bald forehead.
verses.13:43: And the priest shall see him, and look, the appearance of the affliction is reddish-white on his bald head or on his bald forehead, like the form of leprosy in the skin of his flesh,
verses.13:44: he is a leprous person; the priest shall surely declare him unclean; his affliction is on his head.
verses.13:45: And as for the leper on whom the affliction is, let his garments be loosened and his head uncovered, and let him cover around his mouth, and he shall be called unclean.
verses.13:46: All the days that the affliction is on him, being unclean, he shall be unclean; he shall dwell separated; his dwelling shall be outside the camp.
verses.13:47: And as for a garment, if an affliction of leprosy occurs in it, in a woolen garment or in a flax garment,
verses.13:48: or in warp or in weft, or in linen or in wool, or in leather or in any worked leather,
verses.13:49: and the affliction is greenish or reddish in the leather or in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in any worked article of leather, it is an affliction of leprosy, and he shall show it to the priest.
verses.13:50: And the priest shall see the affliction, and the priest shall isolate the affliction for seven days.
verses.13:51: And the priest shall see the affliction on the seventh day; and if the affliction spreads in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in the leather, according to all leather things that may be made in the work, the affliction is a persistent leprosy; it is unclean.
verses.13:52: He shall burn up the garment or the warp or the weft, in wool or in linen or in any leather article in which the affliction is; because it is leprosy, it shall be burned up in fire.
verses.13:53: But if the priest sees, and the affliction does not spread in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in any leather article,
verses.13:54: then the priest shall command, and he shall wash that on which the affliction is, and the priest shall isolate the affliction for seven days a second time.
verses.13:55: And the priest shall see the affliction after it has been washed, and if this affliction has not changed its appearance, and the affliction does not spread, it is unclean; it shall be burned up in fire; it is firmly set in the garment or in the warp or in the weft.
verses.13:56: And if the priest sees, and the affliction is dim after it has been washed, he shall tear it away from the garment or from the leather or from the warp or from the weft.
verses.13:57: But if it still appears in the garment or in the warp or in the weft or in any leather article, it is leprosy breaking out; that in which the affliction is shall be burned up in fire.
verses.13:58: And as for the garment or the warp or the weft or any leather article that is washed and from which the affliction departs, it shall be washed a second time; it shall be clean.
verses.13:59: This is the law of an affliction of leprosy in a woolen or flax garment, or warp or weft, or any leather article, to declare it clean or to declare it unclean."
verses.14:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses, saying,
verses.14:2: "This is the law of the leper on whatever day he is cleansed; and he shall be brought to the priest,
verses.14:3: and the priest shall go outside the camp, and the priest shall look, and indeed, the plague of leprosy is healed from the leper.
verses.14:4: And the priest shall command, and they shall take for the one who has been cleansed two living clean birds, and cedar wood and spun scarlet and hyssop;
verses.14:5: and the priest shall command, and they shall slaughter the one bird into an earthenware bowl over living water;
verses.14:6: and as for the living bird, he shall take it and the cedar wood and the spun scarlet and the hyssop, and he shall dip them and the living bird into the blood of the bird that was slaughtered over living water;
verses.14:7: and he shall sprinkle on the one cleansed from the leprosy seven times, and he shall be clean; and he shall send away the living bird into the field.
verses.14:8: And the one cleansed shall wash his garments, and shall shave all his hair, and shall bathe in water, and he shall be clean, and after these things he shall enter into the camp; and he shall remain outside his house for seven days.
verses.14:9: And it shall be on the seventh day, he shall shave all his hair: his head and his beard and his eyebrows, and all his hair he shall shave; and he shall wash his garments and bathe his body with water, and he shall be clean.
verses.14:10: And on the eighth day he shall take two unblemished year-old lambs, and an unblemished year-old sheep, and three tenths of fine flour for a sacrifice, mixed with oil, and one cup of oil;
verses.14:11: and the priest who cleanses shall set the man who is being cleansed and these things before the Lord, at the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.14:12: And the priest shall take the one lamb, and he shall bring it for the trespass offering, and the cup of oil, and he shall set it apart as a set-apart offering before the Lord.
verses.14:13: And they shall slaughter the lamb in a place where they slaughter the whole burnt offerings and the sin offerings, in a holy place; for the sin offering is like the trespass offering, it belongs to the priest; it is most holy.
verses.14:14: And the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and the priest shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed and on the extremity of the right hand and on the extremity of the right foot;
verses.14:15: and the priest, taking some from the cup of oil, shall pour it onto the left hand of the priest,
verses.14:16: and he shall dip his right finger into some of the oil that is on his left hand, and he shall sprinkle seven times with his finger before the Lord.
verses.14:17: And the priest shall put the remaining oil that is in his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed and on the extremity of the right hand and on the extremity of the right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering;
verses.14:18: and the priest shall put the remaining oil that is on the hand of the priest on the head of the one cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.14:19: And the priest shall offer the sin offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him, the unclean one who is being cleansed from his sin; and after this the priest shall slaughter the whole burnt offering.
verses.14:20: And the priest shall offer up the whole burnt offering and the sacrifice on the altar before the Lord; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he shall be cleansed.
verses.14:21: But if his hand is poor and does not find enough, he shall take one lamb for that in which he trespassed as a set-aside offering, so as to make atonement for him, and a tenth of fine flour mixed with oil for a sacrifice, and one cup of oil,
verses.14:22: and two turtledoves or two young pigeons, whatever his hand has found, and one shall be for a sin offering and one for a whole burnt offering;
verses.14:23: and he shall bring them on the eighth day to the priest to cleanse him, at the door of the tent of testimony, before the Lord.
verses.14:24: And the priest, taking the lamb of the trespass offering and the cup of oil, shall place them as a placed offering before the Lord.
verses.14:25: And he shall slaughter the lamb of the trespass offering, and the priest shall take some of the blood of the trespass offering, and he shall put it on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed and on the extremity of the right hand and on the extremity of the right foot.
verses.14:26: And the priest shall pour some of the oil onto the left hand of the priest;
verses.14:27: and the priest shall sprinkle with his right finger some of the oil that is in his left hand seven times before the Lord;
verses.14:28: and the priest shall put some of the oil that is on his hand on the lobe of the right ear of the one who is being cleansed and on the extremity of his right hand and on the extremity of his right foot, on the place of the blood of the trespass offering;
verses.14:29: and what remains of the oil that is on the hand of the priest he shall put on the head of the one cleansed, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord.
verses.14:30: And he shall offer one of the turtledoves or of the young pigeons, according to what his hand has found,
verses.14:31: one for a sin offering and one for a whole burnt offering, along with the sacrifice; and the priest shall make atonement for the one who is being cleansed before the Lord.
verses.14:32: This is the law of the one in whom is the plague of leprosy and of the one who does not find with his hand for his cleansing."
verses.14:33: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.14:34: "When you enter into the land of the Canaanites, which I give to you as a possession, and I put a plague of leprosy in the houses of the land possessed by you,
verses.14:35: then the one whose house it is shall come and report to the priest, saying, 'Something like a plague has appeared in my house.'
verses.14:36: And the priest shall command that the house be cleared out before the priest enters to look at the house, and whatever is in the house shall by no means become unclean; and after these things the priest shall enter to examine the house.
verses.14:37: And he shall look at the plague in the walls of the house, greenish depressions, and their appearance is lower than the walls;
verses.14:38: and the priest shall go out from the house to the door of the house, and the priest shall isolate the house for seven days.
verses.14:39: And the priest shall return on the seventh day and look at the house, and see, the plague has not spread in the walls of the house;
verses.14:40: and the priest shall command, and they shall remove the stones; there is the plague; and they shall throw them outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:41: And they shall scrape the house inside all around, and they shall pour out the earth outside the city into an unclean place.
verses.14:42: And they shall take scraped solid stones and put them in place of the stones, and they shall take other earth and plaster the house.
verses.14:43: But if a plague comes again and springs up in the house after removing the stones and after the house has been scraped and after it has been plastered,
verses.14:44: then the priest shall enter and look: if the plague has spread in the house, it is a persistent leprosy in the house; it is unclean.
verses.14:45: And they shall tear down the house, and they shall carry out its timbers and its stones and all the earth outside the city into an unclean place;
verses.14:46: and the one who enters into the house all the days that it is isolated shall be unclean until evening,
verses.14:47: and the one who sleeps in the house shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening; and the one who eats in the house shall wash his garments and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.14:48: But if the priest comes and enters and looks, and see, the plague is not spreading at all in the house after the house has been plastered, then the priest shall cleanse the house, because the plague has been healed.
verses.14:49: And he shall take to purify the house two living clean birds and cedar wood and spun scarlet and hyssop;
verses.14:50: and he shall slaughter the one bird into an earthenware vessel over living water,
verses.14:51: and he shall take the cedar wood and the spun scarlet and the hyssop and the living bird, and he shall dip it into the blood of the bird that has been slaughtered over living water, and he shall sprinkle with them on the house seven times.
verses.14:52: And he shall purify the house with the blood of the bird and with the living water and with the living bird and with the cedar wood and with the hyssop and with the spun scarlet;
verses.14:53: and he shall send away the living bird outside the city into the field, and he shall make atonement for the house, and it shall be clean.
verses.14:54: This is the law concerning every plague of leprosy and scab,
verses.14:55: and of the leprosy of a garment and of a house,
verses.14:56: and of a scar and a mark and the bright spot,
verses.14:57: and to declare on which day it is unclean and on which day it will be cleansed; this is the law of leprosy."
verses.15:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses and Aaron, saying,
verses.15:2: "Speak to the sons of Israel, and you shall say to them, 'For any man who has a discharge from his body, his discharge is unclean.
verses.15:3: And this is the law of his uncleanness: when he flows with semen from his body, from the discharge in which his body is obstructed through the discharge, this is his uncleanness in him; all the days of the discharge of his body in which his body is obstructed through the discharge, it is his uncleanness.
verses.15:4: Every bed on which the one with a discharge lies is unclean, and every object on which the one with a discharge sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:5: And any person who touches his bed shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:6: And the one who sits on the object on which the one with a discharge has sat shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:7: And the one who touches the skin of the one with a discharge shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:8: And if the one with a discharge spits on one who is clean, then that one shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:9: And every saddle of a donkey on which the one with a discharge rides shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:10: And everyone who touches whatever things are beneath him shall be unclean until evening; and the one who carries them shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:11: And everyone whom the one with a discharge touches without having rinsed his hands shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:12: And an earthenware vessel that the one with a discharge touches shall be broken, and a wooden vessel shall be rinsed with water and shall be clean.
verses.15:13: And if the one with a discharge is cleansed from his discharge, he shall count off for himself seven days for his cleansing, and he shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and he shall be clean.
verses.15:14: And on the eighth day he shall take for himself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them before the Lord to the doors of the tent of testimony, and give them to the priest.
verses.15:15: And the priest shall offer them, one for a sin offering and one for a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for him before the Lord from his discharge.
verses.15:16: And a man from whom an emission of semen goes out shall bathe his entire body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:17: And every garment and every hide on which there is an emission of semen shall be washed with water and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:18: And as for a woman, if a man lies with her with an emission of semen, they shall bathe in water and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:19: And a woman who is flowing with blood, her discharge being in her body, shall be in her menstruation for seven days; everyone who touches her shall be unclean until evening,
verses.15:20: and everything on which she lies during her menstruation shall be unclean, and everything on which she sits shall be unclean.
verses.15:21: And everyone who touches her bed shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:22: And everyone who touches any object on which she sits shall wash his clothes and bathe in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:23: And if, while she is in her bed or on the object on which she sits, he touches her, it shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:24: And if someone indeed lies with her and her uncleanness comes upon him, he shall be unclean seven days; and every bed on which he lies shall be unclean.
verses.15:25: And if a woman flows with a discharge of blood for many days not at the time of her menstruation, if she also flows after her menstruation, all the days of the discharge of her uncleanness shall be like the days of menstruation; she shall be unclean.
verses.15:26: And every bed on which she lies all the days of the discharge shall be to her like the bed of menstruation, and every object on which she sits shall be unclean like the uncleanness of menstruation.
verses.15:27: Everyone who touches her shall be unclean, and shall wash his clothes and bathe his body in water, and shall be unclean until evening.
verses.15:28: And if she is cleansed from the discharge, she shall count off for herself seven days, and afterward she shall be cleansed.
verses.15:29: And on the eighth day she shall take for herself two turtledoves or two young pigeons, and bring them to the priest to the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.15:30: And the priest shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering, and the priest shall make atonement for her before the Lord from the discharge of her uncleanness.'
verses.15:31: And you shall make the sons of Israel cautious of their uncleannesses, and they shall not die because of their uncleanness when they defile My tent that is among them.
verses.15:32: This is the law of the one with a discharge, and if an emission of semen goes out from anyone so as to be defiled by it,
verses.15:33: and for the woman having a flow of blood in her menstruation, and for the one with a discharge in his discharge, for the male or the female, and for the man who lies with a menstruating woman."
verses.16:1: And the Lord spoke to Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they presented strange fire before the Lord, and they died.
verses.16:2: And the Lord said to Moses, "Speak to Aaron your brother, and let him not enter at all times into the holy place inside the curtain, in front of the mercy seat which is on the ark of testimony, and he shall not die; for I will appear in a cloud over the mercy seat.
verses.16:3: In this way Aaron shall enter the holy place: with a calf from the herd for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:4: And he shall put on a consecrated linen tunic, and linen undergarments shall be on his skin, and he shall wrap himself with a linen sash, and he shall put on a linen turban; they are holy garments, and he shall bathe his entire body in water and put them on.
verses.16:5: And from the congregation of the sons of Israel he shall take two male goats from the goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.
verses.16:6: And Aaron shall present the calf for his sin offering, and make atonement for himself and his household.
verses.16:7: And he shall take the two male goats and set them before the Lord by the door of the tent of testimony.
verses.16:8: And Aaron shall place on the two male goats one lot for the Lord and one lot for the one to be sent away.
verses.16:9: And Aaron shall present the male goat on which the lot for the Lord fell, and offer it for a sin offering.
verses.16:10: And the male goat on which the lot of the one to be sent away fell, he shall set it alive before the Lord to make atonement over it, so as to dispatch it for the sending away; he shall release it into the wilderness.
verses.16:11: And Aaron shall present the calf for the sin offering that is for himself and his household alone, and make atonement for himself and his household, and slaughter the calf for the sin offering that is for himself.
verses.16:12: And he shall take the censer full of coals of fire from the altar that is before the Lord, and he shall fill his hands with incense of fine composition and bring it inside the curtain,
verses.16:13: and he shall put the incense on the fire before the Lord; and the vapor of the incense shall cover the mercy seat that is over the testimonies, and he shall not die.
verses.16:14: And he shall take some of the blood of the calf and sprinkle with his finger on the mercy seat toward the east; in front of the mercy seat he shall sprinkle some of the blood seven times with his finger.
verses.16:15: And he shall slaughter the male goat for the sin offering that is for the people before the Lord, and bring some of its blood inside the curtain, and do with its blood just as he did with the blood of the calf, and sprinkle its blood on the mercy seat, in front of the mercy seat,
verses.16:16: and he shall make atonement for the holy place from the uncleannesses of the sons of Israel and from their wrongdoings, for all their sins; and so he shall do for the tent of testimony that is established among them in the midst of their uncleanness.
verses.16:17: And no person shall be in the tent of testimony when he enters to make atonement in the holy place, until he comes out; and he shall make atonement for himself and his household, and for the entire congregation of the sons of Israel.
